objectives.description: Write scripts/issue-record.sh modeled on events-append.sh, system-defect-record.sh, and orchestrate-record-decision.sh: argument parsing, task-dir/task-N resolution, closed-set validation, lenient class validation, jq -c -n line construction, flock append
Register issue-record.sh in manifest.json's scripts array so deploy-headless.sh installs it (plan did not name this file but it is required for the script to reach .claude/scripts/)
Smoke-test the script against a scratch task directory: normal append, unknown-class warn-and-append, empty --what-happened refusal, --task N resolution success and refusal
shellcheck issue-record.sh -- matches the identical SC1091-info-only baseline already accepted for system-defect-record.sh and orchestrate-record-decision.sh

deviations.description: Register scripts/issue-record.sh in manifest.json's scripts array
deviations.reason: Not named in the plan's Phase 2 file list, but deploy-headless.sh only installs scripts explicitly whitelisted in manifest.json's provides.scripts array -- confirmed by testing (issue-log.md deployed via Phase 1's index-entries.json registration, but issue-record.sh did not appear in .claude/scripts/ after a deploy run until this registration was added). Without it the writer would never reach the deployed tree any later phase's call sites depend on.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added manifest.json registration, not named in the plan's file list, required for deploy to install the script)*
